title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: CD > EAC > CD Wave Editor > Flac level 8
source: Gen 4 SBD Cassettes > SonyTC-W320 > Marantz 510 > CD

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a stellar Weight and intense The Other One, captured on a matrix source that has early hiss from a spliced studio St Stephen.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the electrifying performance – Jerry’s pedal‑steel on The Weight, a monster The Other One, and a melt‑down‑intense Cryptical Envelopment/Viola Lee Blues – plus the rare NRPS set. The recording is a soundboard/ audience matrix; it sounds solid overall but the opening St Stephen contains studio hiss from a splice.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviews are glowing about the music and only one mentions a minor sound issue, yielding an excellent show rating with good‑to‑excellent audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early portion contains a studio splice of St Stephen with noticeable hiss; the rest of the matrix recording is clear and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows strongly, highlighted by the addition of a rare NRPS segment and a high‑octane electric Dead second half that builds to intense peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for pedal‑steel on The Weight and distinctive backing vocals; also featured with Ace in the NRPS set.
